summary: Maze Therapeutics filed an 8-K on October 15, 2026 disclosing a Section 3(a)(9) exchange agreement with Frazier Life Sciences funds (Frazier Public Fund, X, XI, XII). The holder exchanged 2,776,007 common shares for pre-funded warrants on the same share count at a $0.001 exercise price, leaving 53,931,889 shares outstanding. Warrants are immediately exercisable but carry a 9.99% beneficial-ownership blocker and no voting rights except as Delaware law requires. This is a tax- and registration-efficient resale-enabling recapitalization, not a change of control; watch for warrant exercises and any Frazier stake reduction as a supply overhang.
